reason: Having seen the last campaign end in refunds, I mostly need to believe this one can reach its goal. A shows $36,000 already committed and only $49,000 left, barely more than the town gave before and about $7.50 a head, so a modest pledge feels worthwhile after my ambulance donation. B leaves out the business pledges and tells me we need $13,000 more than last time's failed total, which makes it sound like another refund, despite its nice Thanksgiving date.
